scope: Negative controls for the writfold.agent/1 control-protocol seed; each module is Control.tla with exactly one documented deviation and must violate its target invariant under TLC

mutants.name: M1-grant-authority
mutants.deviation: initialize sets authority' = TRUE in InitOk
mutants.contract_rule: identity: initialization grants no corpus read or edit authority

mutants.name: M2-commit-before-encode
mutants.deviation: InitOk commits the initialized phase without any completely encoded success reply
mutants.contract_rule: encoding_failure: no successful lifecycle change precedes successful complete encoding

mutants.name: M3-reinitialize
mutants.deviation: repeated initialize recommits the initialized phase instead of refusing

mutants.name: M4-shutdown-without-init
mutants.deviation: shutdown commits from an uninitialized session instead of erroring

mutants.name: M5-substitute-null-id
mutants.deviation: an admitted request's correlated error reply substitutes a null id
mutants.contract_rule: stream_safety: correlation ids are preserved, not normalized or substituted

mutants.name: M6-read-after-stop
mutants.deviation: requests remain readable after the shutdown commit
mutants.contract_rule: shutdown_order: flush and close without reading another request

mutants.name: M7-generation-on-reject
mutants.deviation: a malformed envelope consumes an invocation generation
mutants.contract_rule: identity: malformed JSON/envelopes consume no generation
